Name: Pedaiah
Summary: Stood beside Ezra at the reading of the law (Nehemiah 8:4), repaired a section of the wall as son of Parosh (Nehemiah 3:25), and served as a treasurer over the storehouses (Nehemiah 13:13).
LifeLesson: One Levite could stand, build, and keep the storehouses.
RelatedEvents: Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall; Ezra Reads the Law
